title: Rolled Life
description: The Datapack that was used in rolled life.
body:
This is a spin on **Grian's life series.**

# Rolled Life: 
At the start of the series, you will be rolled from 8-5 Lives, with a higher chance of being rolled from 6-7, and a lower chance of 8 and 5.


- If you’re at **8 Lives, you're pink and peaceful. Same with aqua, 6-7 Lives**
- If you’re at **4-5 Lives, you’re dark green. Dark Greens Can Kill Pinks**
- **3 - Lives Lime. Limes Can Kill Aqua + Pinks**
- **2 -  Lives Yellow. Yellows Can Kill Dark Greens, Aqua, And Pink**
- **1 - Live Red. And Reds Can Kill EVERYONE**
- **0 - Lives And Your _“Out”_.**

Every Session, Roles Will Be Rolled, Which May change how you play that session!
And Every Session, The Roles May Change!!

Please enjoy this datapack

## Recommended:
 - Simple Voice Chat
 - Carpet Mod (Helps if players leave.)

## Session Themes:


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

(1-2) Mafia
(3-4) King
(5) Cult
(6) Mobs
(7) Hatred
(8) Teams
(9) All of the above.

</details>
